name: file-canary
description: Plants realistic lure files containing a honeytoken credential and reports every open, read, change, rename or deletion of them.
author: TrueSignal
documentation: An init container without network creates missing lures (never overwriting existing files, never following symlinks); the sensor then watches the lure directories read-only with inotify, so deleted and recreated lures stay covered. Both run as UID 0 with every capability dropped except DAC_OVERRIDE (to reach lure directories owned by other users); the sensor's mounts are read-only. The sensor cannot see which process touched a lure (source is 'local'): correlate with EDR telemetry for the same host and time. Lure directories must exist before deploying.

config.name: TS_LURES
config.description: Absolute paths of lure files to plant and watch (their directories must exist)

config.name: TS_HONEYTOKEN
config.description: Honeytoken credential issued by the Hub

config.name: TS_ACCESS_ALERTS
config.description: Report opens and reads (not only tampering)

config.name: TS_ACCESS_COOLDOWN_SEC
config.description: Minimum seconds between access events per lure

config.name: TS_TAMPER_COOLDOWN_SEC
config.description: Minimum seconds between tamper events per lure and action

triggers.name: decoy_file_accessed
triggers.description: A lure file was opened or read

triggers.name: decoy_file_tampered
triggers.description: A lure file was modified, renamed, deleted or had its attributes changed
